  director = 'Various (showrunner: Erik Oleson)',
  `cast` = 'Charlie Cox as Matt Murdock / Daredevil, Vincent D''Onofrio as Wilson Fisk / Kingpin, Wilson Bethel as Benjamin Poindexter / Bullseye, Deborah Ann Woll as Karen Page, Elden Henson as Foggy Nelson, Joanne Whalley as Sister Maggie',
  tagline = 'The Devil is reborn. The greatest superhero season ever made — a masterpiece of television.',
  description = 'Daredevil Season 3 finds Matt Murdock broken and abandoned after the events of The Defenders, questioning his faith and identity while Wilson Fisk orchestrates his release from prison and recruits a psychopathic FBI agent as a new Daredevil.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/daredevil-s3-featured-LafffdNUUSbziMts7Ld38S.webp',
  episodeCount = 13, seasonCount = 3, platform = 'Netflix',
  rtCriticsScore = 97, rtAudienceScore = 93, verdict = 'hit',
  cardMarketContent = '## Daredevil S3 Cards: Peak Netflix Marvel Collectibles

Daredevil Season 3 is widely considered the best season of any Netflix Marvel show, and cards from this era carry a premium. Bullseye''s introduction and Kingpin''s return make for compelling card subjects. The **2019 Upper Deck Marvel Premier** set captures this era beautifully, with Kingpin cards being particularly sought after given Vincent D''Onofrio''s continued MCU presence.',
  keyCards = '- **2019 Upper Deck Marvel Premier Kingpin** — Vincent D''Onofrio''s iconic villain, $15-40
- **2019 Marvel Premier Bullseye/Poindexter** — First appearance of the MCU Bullseye, $10-25
- **2019 Marvel Annual Daredevil Black Suit** — The iconic black suit return, $8-20
- **2019 Marvel Premier Charlie Cox Autograph** — Rare signed Daredevil card, $80-200+',
  content = '## The Greatest Superhero Season Ever Made

Daredevil Season 3 is not just the best Netflix Marvel season — many consider it the best season of superhero television ever produced. Erik Oleson stripped everything away from Matt Murdock: his faith, his friends, his suit, his identity. What remained was raw, broken humanity trying to find a reason to keep fighting.

## Kingpin Returns

Vincent D''Onofrio''s Wilson Fisk returned with a masterplan that was terrifying in its simplicity — use the system itself as a weapon. His manipulation of the FBI, the media, and eventually Bullseye showed a villain operating at peak intelligence. Every scene with Fisk crackled with menace.

## The Prison Fight: Television''s Greatest Action Sequence

The prison riot one-shot in Episode 4 is widely considered the greatest single action sequence in television history. An 11-minute continuous take following Matt through a prison riot, fighting dozens of inmates with no suit and no weapons. It''s breathtaking filmmaking.

## Bullseye: Born

Wilson Bethel''s Benjamin Poindexter was a revelation — a psychopath wearing the Daredevil suit, committing atrocities in Matt''s name. His origin episode exploring his childhood was chilling, and his eventual transformation into Bullseye set up a villain fans are still waiting to see again.

## Fun Facts

- The prison fight was actually filmed in one take over multiple days of rehearsal
- Vincent D''Onofrio lost and gained weight multiple times to show Fisk''s prison transformation
- The season was written as a potential series finale, giving it narrative completeness
- Charlie Cox has called Season 3 his proudest work as an actor
- The black suit return was a deliberate callback to Frank Miller''s Born Again comic arc',
  metaDescription = 'Daredevil Season 3 (2018) complete guide — the masterpiece season, Kingpin''s return, Bullseye''s origin, trading card values, and why this is peak superhero television.',
  keywords = 'daredevil season 3, kingpin, vincent donofrio, bullseye, charlie cox, born again, netflix marvel, marvel cards, prison fight',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Daredevil Kingpin cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is Daredevil Season 3 the best Marvel TV season?","answer":"It is widely considered the best, with a 97% critics score on Rotten Tomatoes. Critics and fans praise its storytelling, performances (particularly Vincent D''Onofrio), and the iconic prison fight sequence."},{"question":"Do I need to watch The Defenders before Season 3?","answer":"Yes, Season 3 picks up directly after The Defenders'' ending, with Matt recovering from the building collapse. The Defenders provides essential context."},{"question":"Is the prison fight really one take?","answer":"Yes, the 11-minute prison riot sequence in Episode 4 was designed and filmed as a single continuous shot, widely regarded as one of the greatest action sequences in television history."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'daredevil-season-3-2018'
